t:
The Rafflesia arnoldii is the largest flower in the world. It grows in the rainforests of Sumatra and can reach one meter in diameter. Unlike most flowers, it smells like rotting meat in order to attract flies.

What is the purpose of the flower's bad smell?
o: To help the flower grow faster
To protect it from strong wind

t:
One hot day, a thirsty crow found a pitcher with a little water at the bottom. The crow could not reach the water, so it dropped small stones into the pitcher one by one. Slowly, the water rose to the top, and the crow drank happily.

What can we learn from the story?
o: We should always drink a lot of water.
Small stones are more useful than water.
We must not drink water from a pitcher.
We can solve problems with patience and cleverness.

t:
How to Make a Cup of Tea
1. Boil some water.
2. Put a tea bag into a cup.
3. Pour the hot water into the cup.
4. Wait for about three minutes.
5. Stir well and add sugar if you like.

What should you do right after pouring the hot water into the cup?
o: Put another tea bag into the cup

t:

t:

o: It lives only in Australian rivers.

t:

What will Andi probably do next?
o: Wait under the tree until the rain stops
Run home quickly in the rain
Buy a new umbrella at the school shop
Walk home together under the girl's umbrella

t:
Our school library opens from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. Students may borrow two books at a time. Books must be returned within one week. A fine of Rp1,000 per day is charged for late returns.

Which statements are true based on the text?
o: Students can borrow more than two books at a time.
Students may borrow two books at one time.
The library closes at four in the afternoon.
Students do not pay a fine if they are late.

t:
Dita: Hi, Bayu. Are you free this afternoon?
Bayu: I think so. Why?
Dita: I'm going to the bookstore to buy a dictionary. Would you like to come along?
Bayu: Sure, I'd love to. What time are we going?

Which statements are true based on the dialogue?
o: Dita invites Bayu to go to the bookstore.
Bayu agrees to go with Dita.
Dita asks Bayu to buy a dictionary for her.

t:
HOW TO KEEP YOUR CLASSROOM CLEAN
1. Throw rubbish into the bin.
2. Clean the whiteboard after the lesson.
3. Arrange the chairs and desks before you leave.
4. Turn off the lights and fans when the room is empty.

According to the text, what should the students do?
o: Arrange the chairs and desks before leaving.
Turn off the lights and fans.
Open all the windows during the lesson.
Write their names on the whiteboard.

t:

Which statements are true based on the text?
o: They finished the clean-up at night.
They felt sorry for joining the program.
They went to the beach on Sunday.
They collected plastic bottles and wrappers.
